prompt_assertion.added_line: Articles: the previous point is about the CHOICE of article. An article that English grammar REQUIRES and the learner sentence simply leaves out ("Dad will buy new fridge.", "It is cold in kitchen today.") is not acceptable English and is DIFF. An English article is a grammatical requirement of the target language, and Slovak has no article to omit in the first place, so nothing was dropped in translation: the sentence is simply not grammatical English. Where more than one determiner is grammatical (a / the / a possessive / no article where English allows it), the choice stays free and is SAME on that point.
